glosses: To furnish with dress or equipments, especially those for military service

examples.text: […] Ile hold thee any wager / When we are both accoutered like yong men, / Ile proue the prettier fellow of the two, […]
Vpon the word, / Accoutred as I was, I plunged in,
For this, in rags accoutered, are they seen, / And made the may-game of the public spleen?
